prompt: 對城市 eu-gbr-london-lm（variant orig）執行 LLM 消融基線 llm-skeleton2grid：從骨架地圖由模型自行逐點指派整數格座標，模型 fable5，強制重跑（先 reset 再從零重算）。

transcript.note: Round 1: monotone hand-bucketing. Columns = 42 hand-chosen consecutive gx bands, rows = 45 gy bands, so every cross-bucket pair keeps its real east/west and north/south sign and the canvas shrinks from 112x113 to 42x45. Band cuts were picked to align lines: Victoria 24-68-64 and the Warren St chain 72-106-7 vertical; the District row 78-30-18-82-19 horizontal; Jubilee 6-104-44 horizontal straight through the river crossing; the Bank cluster 48-12, 48-103-21 vertical; Circle's Paddington leg 5-25-90 one 45-degree diagonal. Lambeth North (45) nearly coincides with crossing 105 in geography (half a pixel apart), so its cell was chosen purely by winding order at 44 and 105: west-southwest of both, at (23,10); the two ~0.3-0.4% east/west inversions against Waterloo and Brixton this causes are the price of keeping the winding cycles intact. Chalfont (91) sits at (1,40) so the 56-91 segment passes no lattice point (Croxley would otherwise sit on it).
transcript.noteZh: 第一輪：手工單調分桶。欄＝42 個手選連續 gx 帶、列＝45 個 gy 帶——跨桶對必保真實東西／南北符號，畫布從 112×113 縮到 42×45。切帶位置刻意讓路線對齊：維多利亞線 24-68-64 與 72-106-7 垂直、District 的 78-30-18-82-19 整列水平、Jubilee 6-104-44 水平直穿河流交叉點、Bank 群 48-12 與 48-103-21 垂直、Circle 的 5-25-90 成一條 45° 對角線。Lambeth North（45）與交叉點 105 地理上幾乎重合（差半個 px），格子完全由 44 與 105 的環繞序決定：放在兩者西南側 (23,10)；因此對 Waterloo 與 Brixton 產生的兩個約 0.3–0.4% 東西翻轉，是保住環繞序的代價。Chalfont（91）放 (1,40) 讓 56-91 段不經過任何格點（否則 Croxley 會壓在段上）。
